This "buddy" card for [[Leia Organa{{!}}Leia]] and [[Han Solo{{!}}Han]] is arguably one of the best cards to come out of the [[Endor (location){{!}}Endor]] set. It is also considered one of the best "destiny adder" card because of its other non-destiny adding function. Not only does this card allow you to add two battle destinies if you have both of the persona together, you can also use it to get [[Leia Organa{{!}}Leia]] and a matching weapon. Also, since deploying [[Leia Organa{{!}}Leia]] is free, you can bypass things like Bad Feeling I Have.

Combos: Millenium [[Millennium Falcon{{!}}Falcon]] + Captain [[Han Solo{{!}}Han]] + [[I Know]] (+ EPP [[Leia Organa{{!}}Leia]]): Commonly known as the basis for the "Super [[Millennium Falcon{{!}}Falcon]]." If you don't already have EPP [[Leia Organa{{!}}Leia]] out (from the Enhanced Premiere Packs), now you do. Captain [[Han Solo{{!}}Han]] and EPP [[Leia Organa{{!}}Leia]] each add a battle destiny, and you will have enough ability to draw another one. This combo even gets around the dreaded [[Zuckuss In Mist Hunter]].

[[General Solo]] + [[I Know]] (+ EPP [[Leia Organa{{!}}Leia]] OR + [[Daughter Of Skywalker]] + [[Anakin's Lightsaber]] OR + [[Leia's Blaster Rifle]]): A great combination to have on [[Endor (location){{!}}Endor]]. [[Daughter Of Skywalker]]'s scout attribute allows [[General Solo]] to cancel a battle destiny. And being armed with the family lightsaber, [[Leia Organa{{!}}Leia]] can do some damage on [[Endor (location){{!}}Endor]]. Or even use her own powerful blaster and really do serious damage in battles.
